# Use token membership selectors for multi-value row properties

Current grouping styles use [data-properties~="dummy"] and [data-show-grouped-by-sort~="true"]. The selector checks a token in the attribute value rather than assuming dummy is the entire value. Proposed manual selector rule: preserve membership semantics for token-list row metadata when adding sibling selectors. This is a scoped syntax pattern, not a demand to use ~= for every data attribute.

Scope: mail/themes/shared/mail.
